Evidence: benchmark.cpp, implementations.h, notes.txt, README.md and the generated/ directory; the talk itself states the final speedups. LICENSE is CC-BY-NC-ND (non-OSI: usability reference). The technique is reimplemented from scratch in private:developer-source (fastcpp::phf); mention that in caveats.
